lots.what_it_is: Two mounted (matted, unframed) mixed media portrait heads by Ryllton Viney (b. 1944, Launceston), signed in pencil and dated 2003 and 2009
lots.guide_summary: Nothing survives: no sold, unsold or asking evidence for Ryllton Viney works on paper. The researcher found none and my own WebSearch hit the session cap, so I could not add any. Gowans API for 'viney' and 'ryllton' returns only vineyard wine lots.
lots.working: No SOLD evidence, so both maximum bids are 0.
lots.confidence_reason: Signature read but no price evidence of any kind.
lots.dropped_entries: None submitted. Researcher correctly excluded Wayne Viney (different artist).
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1 shows two separate mounts. Head in profile with striped headdress, signed 'Ryllton Viney 2003' in pencil on the mount; three-quarter face on blue ground signed 'Ryllton Viney 2009'. Pencil signature matches the hand on the back of lot 1120. Works appear to be original mixed media (textured pastel or oil over ground), not prints. No frames.
lots.condition: Mounts look clean in the photos; unframed so exposed to handling; no visible damage to the images.
lots.question_for_armitage: Are these originals or prints, are they signed on the work or only on the mount, and what are the image sizes?

lots.guide_summary: Mostly sold: eight Gowans Hobart hammers for Hamadan-region rugs and runners $170 to $330 (Nov 2025 to Jun 2026), one Baluchi guide at $180, no unsold, and one dealer retail asking price $1,100 for a new Koliai runner. Realistic auction band is $170 to $330 hammer. All AUD, rate 1.0.
lots.working: Keep: lowest surviving close SOLD (Hamadan 150x82cm, $170 hammer) / 1.22 = $139.34, round down to $135. Flip: likely resale about $220 hammer (middle of the $170 to $330 Gowans band, discounted because lot 1082 is dirty), less about 15% seller commission ($33), no outbound postage (local room sale) = $187; $187 / 2.44 = $76.6, round down to $75. Pickup Invermay, inbound freight $0. Comparables are dealer stock likely washed, and lot 1082 size is unknown, so treat these maxima as ceilings.
lots.confidence_reason: Clear type identification and many opened Gowans SOLD results, but no size given, condition is dirtier than the comparables and Gowans titles say Hamadan, not Kolyai specifically.
lots.dropped_entries: Meshwani runners $90 to $160 (aggregated entry): dropped, Afghan narrow runners, not the same type, and an averaged 'aud_price 130' is not a single sale. Baluchi 366x75cm $240: dropped, long narrow Baluchi, not comparable. RugMaster entry kept but moved from 'close' to 'category guide' (new retail stock) and now page opened.
lots.key_photo_findings: Classic Kolyai layout: four hooked diamond medallions alternating ivory and rust centres on a dark brown and rust field with small scattered motifs, navy border with rosettes, ivory guard stripes. Red overcast sides, short fringe remnants at ends. Field looks dusty or dirty with uneven sheen and possible low pile in the centre (photo 3). No holes visible, but the ends and back are not shown. Ratio about 1.8 to 1, so a rug rather than a long runner.
lots.condition: Used, dirty or dusty, some wear to the pile; sides overcast; ends not clearly shown; needs a wash. Size unknown.
lots.question_for_armitage: What are the dimensions? Any holes, moth damage, repairs or worn foundation showing on the back, and are both ends and fringes intact? Does it smell or need washing?

lots.what_it_is: Ryllton Viney (b. 1944, Launceston), 'Neither Here Nor There', No. 3 of the series 'The Nordic North', oil and acrylic on Magnani Pescia paper, signed and dated 2013, small image in large mount and timber frame
lots.guide_summary: Nothing survives. The only entry (Gallery Pejean retail $3,500 for a large canvas) was snippet only, the page returns 404 when fetched, and it is a different size and medium. No sold, unsold or asking evidence; WebSearch hit the session cap so I could not look further.
lots.working: No SOLD evidence, so both maximum bids are 0.
lots.confidence_reason: Label and signature read clearly, but no price evidence.
lots.dropped_entries: Gallery Pejean ASKING $3,500 dropped: URL returns HTTP 404 (checked 2026-10-16), price was snippet only and never verified, and it is a 183x122cm canvas, not comparable to a small work on paper.
lots.key_photo_findings: Front: dark layered horizon abstract, pencil signature 'Ryllton Viney' and '2013' on mount. Back of frame: signed and dated 2013, inscribed 'No. 3 of the Series The Nordic North / Neither Here Nor There / Oil and acrylic on Magnani Pescia Paper', with a printed gallery-style label 'Neither Here Nor There, Oil and acrylic on paper'. Light timber frame, wire hanger.
lots.condition: Frame and mount look clean; no foxing or damage visible in the photos.
lots.question_for_armitage: What are the image and frame sizes, and is there any gallery label or receipt (for example Gallery Pejean or Madeline Gordon) with the original price?
